Title: Diagnosis of test `testByteToStringVariations` failure

Details:
The test `testByteToStringVariations` is failing at the assertion comparing the expected Base64-encoded string of the bytes of "Hello World" with the result returned from `Base64.encodeBase64String(b1)`.

The failure message:

```
byteToString static Hello World expected:<SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=[]> but was:<SGVsbG8gV29ybGQ=[\n]>
```

This indicates that `Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[])` method appends a newline at the end of the encoded string, causing the mismatch.

We need to verify the behavior of `encodeBase64String(byte[])`, particularly whether it adds trailing newline characters by default.
